title: 9% in two trading weeks.
author: Zephyr_Labs
selftext:
Starting out, Argus was kicking ass.  
Then this past week happened.

I’m spending the weekend analyzing the info, but again, no changes will be made to the grading or purchasing logic for the next 20 sessions.

For anyone asking, yes, the system accounts for slippage and actual trading costs inside of its pricing model. 

So my numbers are not just an inflated fantasy I’ve pulled out of my ass.

The whole point of this “Silly Paper Trader” is a 30 day untouched run.

So week 1 - Up roughly 14%

Week 2 - lost 6% before a short rebound resulting in an overall loss for the week of 2.09%

Total gains for the two trading weeks

Up 9.53% - $95.28

If the gains persist and the logic is able to do what it is supposed to do, I have a quant lined up to validate it at the end of its 30 session run.
